values.en: The **positive 90-degree rotation of the plane** is the map $J\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$, $J(x,y)=(-y,x)$: the counter-clockwise rotation by $90^{\circ}$. It is linear and isometric, $\langle Jv,Jw\rangle=\langle v,w\rangle$, it satisfies $J^{2}=-\mathrm{id}$, and $\langle Jv,v\rangle=0$ for every $v$, so $J$ sends each vector to its positive orthogonal direction.
values.zh-CN: **平面正向 $90^\circ$ 旋转**是映射 $J\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$，$J(x,y)=(-y,x)$，即逆时针旋转 $90^{\circ}$。它是线性等距映射，$\langle Jv,Jw\rangle=\langle v,w\rangle$，满足 $J^{2}=-\mathrm{id}$，且对每个 $v$ 都有 $\langle Jv,v\rangle=0$，故 $J$ 把每个向量送到它的正向正交方向。
